consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer, which asks 'what item does the GUI show in the wielded slot and in each worn body-part slot?'
scope: The paperdoll's slot-organized DISPLAY view of the wielded item and worn slots only (filtered/formatted per slot), not the raw full carried-item containers including all inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and the entire inv_const_slice() as flat item objects (type_id/charges/count_by_charges), i.e. raw simulation state, not the paperdoll's filtered slot display
divergence: An avatar wearing an integrated/hidden worn layer (e.g. a transparent/non-displayed armor entry) plus loose inventory items: write_carried_items emits the hidden worn item and every inventory item, but the paperdoll would show neither in a visible worn slot, so the surface reports items the display would never paint
